meaning.en: An hourglass used for measuring time by the flow of sand.
meaning.vi: Đồng hồ cát dùng để đo thời gian theo dòng chảy của cát.

meaning.en: An instrument for measuring the passage of time by the passage of sand through a narrow opening.
